source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 2, 10. Λυπηρὰ διηγεῖται θεάματα έν τῷ χωρίῳ τῆς εὐφροσύνης γεγενημένα· φόβῳ γὰρ οὐδὲ θρηνεῖν τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις ἐπέτρεπον, καὶ τὰς πρώτας παρθένους εἰς γῆν ὁρᾶν παρεσκεύασαν, μήποτε φανεῖσαι πρὸς βίαν αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κάλλους, ἐν ᾦπερ ἐπρώτευον, ἐπισπάσωνται. εἴποις δ' ἂν καὶ τοὺς έν ἀρετῇ πάλαι πρεσβεύοντας, δι' ἣν οὕτως ἐλέγοντο, χοϊκοὺς γεγονότας καὶ πάθεσιν ἀλόγοις ἐνιδρυθέντας κατὰ λόγον ἔτι μηδὲν ἐνεργεῖν καὶ τὸ έν αὐτοῖς ἡγεμονικὸν ἀπογεώσαντας πνεῦμα καὶ πένθους ἀξίαν, ἣν εἶχον πάλαι, σωφροσύνην ποιήσαντας καὶ λογισμοὺς διαφθείραντας, οὓς πρὶν ἀφθόρους δοἐσῳζον.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] He narrates painful sights that have come to be in the place of gladness; for by fear they were not permitting even the elders to lament, and they prepared the first virgins to look unto the earth, lest appearing they draw them by force from the beauty in which they were foremost. And you would also say those long ago elders in virtue—for which they were so called—having become earthy and settled in irrational passions, still do nothing according to reason, and having made earthy the leading spirit in them and having made the sobriety they once had worthy of mourning and having corrupted reasonings which formerly they were keeping incorrupt.
pass_b_english: He narrates painful sights that have come to be in the place of gladness; for by fear they were not permitting even the elders to lament, and they prepared the first virgins to look unto the earth, lest appearing they draw them by force from the beauty in which they were foremost. And you would also say those long ago elders in virtue—for which they were so called—having become earthy and settled in irrational passions, still do nothing according to reason, and having made earthy the leading spirit in them and having made the sobriety they once had worthy of mourning and having corrupted reasonings which formerly they were keeping incorrupt.
